beats.say: Swatting that wasp... is the *worst* thing you can do.
Not because it stings. Because it calls for *backup.*
You're eating outside, and a wasp lands on your *lemonade.*
So you roll up a newspaper... and *splat.*
But a crushed wasp leaks an *alarm chemical* from its venom sac.
To other wasps nearby, that smell means *attack.*
And the guards come out, looking for a *fight.*
Unlike honeybees, wasps can sting *again and again.*
Wasp expert Peter Landolt says a smashed wasp alerts the *guards.*
And waving your arms? Wasp eyes are tuned to *sudden movement.*
Most of the time, it just wants your *sugar.* Not you.
Stay calm, move away *slowly*, and cover your drink.
Indoors? Trap it under a *glass*, and let it go outside.
So next time a wasp lands on your lemonade... remember:
